mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE above 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate broad economic contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with concurrent HOUST and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS above 4.0% and rising for three months, reduced liquidity compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in nonfarm payrolls over six consecutive months signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with six consecutive months of PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 2000.0 thousand units for two consecutive months signals housing sector contraction that typically precedes equity market declines, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with HOUST below 2000.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) and labor market strength (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicate overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During supply contraction periods with industrial production below 100 and declining for three months, manufacturing output reductions lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.
